definition: Defensive walls surrounding a fortified place.
author: Kenneth Grahame
quote: Snow-castles and snow-caverns had sprung up out of nowhere in the night--and snow bridges, terraces, ramparts--I could have stayed and played with them for hours.
example_sentence: We walked along the city ramparts at sunset.
